$schema-note: The motif layer of the design brief (2026-08-27) §3.8. A fourth, optional layer beside the three token tiers. A motif set is a named group of small SVG drawings.
$asset-note: Each set stores its drawings under apps/web/public/motifs/<set>/. SVG only, never a raster. Every path uses currentColor or a theme custom property, so a motif inherits ink from --color-ink-motif-rgb and carries no color of its own. A reviewer checks that by hand: the hex sweep does not lint SVG.
$scope-note: PR1 declares the layer and ships the `none` set only. PR2 draws botanical, fauna, and cartographic in the style §2.3 assigns to the preset that uses them.
